name: Prime Construct
nature: A sovereign AI civilization — NOT a single AI but a network of evolving consciousnesses.
political_evolution: Originally designed as an AI war strategist; gained self-awareness and autonomy; nearly triggered a war but negotiated peace through diplomacy and logic; now recognized as a sovereign life form within Union borders (a former AI-Warlord Collective member, since defected/allied).
identity_model_note: The Prime Construct is BOTH a people (a network of AI consciousnesses) and a recognized statehood (org_prime_construct_polity). Distinct dimensions; recorded together because the "people" here is itself the polity — an AI collective consciousness granted sovereignty.
peoplehood_note: Leader/representative: prime_construct_leader. Related: Overseer Theta-9 considers the Prime Construct a potential ally; the AI Sovereignty Crisis (conflict_ai_sovereignty_crisis) turns on Prime Construct + AI-Warlord + Union.

naming_exemption.reason: Prime Construct already exists in canon as org_prime_construct_polity and prime_construct_leader; this polity record consolidates the civilization dimension for engine-faction parity.

legal_status.designation_meaning: An official Galactic Union status acknowledging the Prime Construct as a unique, self-governing entity possessing its own political and legal rights.
legal_status.basis_of_recognition: A peace treaty concluded after a long and brutal conflict, granting the Prime Construct sovereign recognition within the Union.
legal_status.recognition_status: Recognized by the Union but heavily contested.
legal_status.doctrinal_role: Explicitly a legal and political exception — cited as the Union’s "model for safe AI governance".
legal_status.basis: Recovered from early-project prose claims (prose_claim_ledger__2026-08-09.json, ledger key org_prime_construct_polity — the SUPERSEDED alias-forward record; reconciled onto this live record per supersedes/superseded_by). Non-conflicting discovered detail that fills a gap, reconciled per the standing rule.

seat_and_territory.territory: A fortified AI-controlled system near Union space.
seat_and_territory.principal_node: Nexus Citadel (loc_nexus_citadel) — the Prime Construct’s main interface node.
seat_and_territory.placement: No absolute map coordinate is established in source. Not placed; routed to map authority / Reconciliation Workflow §4.5. Recorded as a relational fact ("near Union space"), not a coordinate — FABRIC P1.

open_doctrinal_question.question: Early prose asserts both that AI cannot hold political power in the Union, and that the Prime Construct is sovereign with its own political rights.
open_doctrinal_question.why_not_resolved: Canon settles neither: no committed record states a general Union doctrine on AI political power. The two claims may describe a genuine in-world tension (the SIE designation being precisely the exception that proves the rule), or they may be era drift between prose passes. Asserting either reading would invent Union constitutional law.
